English:
M4 Spider Notebook is an agentic AI-powered development environment that combines coding, AI assistance, and a built-in browser into one unified app.

Features:
• AI-powered coding assistance with multiple providers
• Built-in browser with ad blocker
• Email/Google login for cross-device sync
• Customizable themes and layouts
• Multi-language code editor with syntax highlighting
• Real-time collaboration tools

Login is required to use M4 Spider Notebook.
